name: Fault-free game
summary: Competitive full-court game to 11 started by a serve; each player tallies every rally they end with their own fault of any kind.
setup: Play singles rallies on the full court, each started by a serve; serve and play as your rules allow (the fault rules are UNVERIFIED in this app)
Play every rally out live and competitively
Each player tallies the rallies they end with their own fault: serve, two-bounce, foot or non-volley-zone faults, or other
Game to 11 rallies; play 2 games and add up the faults
success_criterion: Over 2 games to 11, end at most 2 rallies with your own faults
safety_notes: Live rallies can include lobs and fast changes of direction: turn and run back for a lob, never backpedal. Stop if dizzy or in pain.
coach_rationale: (judgment) In competitive play faults appear under fatigue and score pressure; a full game that counts every own fault, whatever the subtype, measures the AN-07 fault share in conditions close to a match. Unverified coaching content until a human coach reviews the library (P15).
